scripts.xterm-css: mkdir -p build-temp && cp node_modules/@xterm/xterm/css/xterm.css build-temp/xterm.css && node build-src/digest-css.ts xterm build-temp dist
scripts.uno-css: mkdir -p build-temp && unocss --config build-src/uno.config.ts && node build-src/digest-css.ts uno build-temp dist
scripts.build-info-json: mkdir -p build/app && node build-src/build-info.ts dist .mjs .css | tee build/app/build-info.json
scripts.index-html: mkdir -p build/app && cat src/index.html | node build-src/process-page.ts src/index.sub.json dist | node build-src/embed-digest.ts > build/app/index.html
scripts.story-html: mkdir -p build/app && cat src/story.html | node build-src/process-page.ts src/story.sub.json dist > build/app/story.html
scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm run app-mjs && pnpm run xterm-css && pnpm run uno-css && pnpm run build-info-json && pnpm run index-html && pnpm run story-html
scripts.build-test: node --test build-src/process-page.ts build-src/embed-digest.ts build-src/digest-css.ts build-src/build-info.ts build-src/uno.config.ts
